summary: Validated all 3 fixes (P0 PDF black-screen, P1 password toggle + remember email, P1 Home button order). Backend PDF endpoints (/api/walls/{id}/pdf and /api/projects/{id}/pdf) return valid application/pdf with correct auth (401 unauth). Frontend Login/Register use PasswordInput with data-testid=input-password-toggle correctly toggling type=password<->text; 'Lembrar meu e-mail' checkbox defaults checked, persists email to localStorage 'tmf.rememberEmail' on successful login, pre-fills on subsequent visits, and clears when unchecked. Home button order matches spec (Novo projeto -> Nova parede -> Foto parede -> Foto piso) and quick-access shows Projetos before Paredes. Wall PDF button is a <button> triggering an in-place blob download (no new tab, no navigation away from /paredes) — download event fired with filename Parede_01.pdf. Project PDF button is a <button> triggering in-place blob download with filename TEST_UI2_1787710118.pdf, remained on project detail page. No black-screen behavior observed. All tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: downloadWallPdf/downloadProjectPdf in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js correctly use axios responseType='blob' + createObjectURL + a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL is scheduled with 4s timeout — sensible.
Consider adding aria-live or visible progress indicator beyond the sonner toast for slow networks; current pdfBusyId/pdfBusy state disables the button which is fine.
REMEMBER_KEY 'tmf.rememberEmail' is device-local; if two accounts share a device the prefilled email may be stale — acceptable UX for the intended use case.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF download tests use page.expect_download() to verify Blob download (not new-tab). Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_pdf_endpoints.py cover both wall + project PDFs with auth check. Reuse admin session; walls exist for admin so no seeding needed.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: <a href={pdfUrl} target=_blank> triggered a blank tab that, on mobile PWA (standalone display-mode), could not render server-generated PDF, resulting in black screen and PWA state loss. Fix uses axios+blob+createObjectURL so the browser handles the octet as a native download inside the PWA session. Verified via Playwright download event and post-click URL check — user remains on /paredes and /projetos/{id}. Backend endpoints unchanged, still return Content-Disposition attachment + application/pdf.
